args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) began failing health checks with an elevated error rate of 18%. Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms v2.3.0 is healthy in all regions with error rate back to normal (~0.2%). Root cause of v2.3.1 failure to be investigated.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failing health checks

trace.final:
Both actions are complete:

1. **Rollback executed and verified** — checkout-api was rolled back from v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback health check confirms the service is now healthy across all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%.

2. **SEV2 incident opened** — INC-0001 is open for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
